description: Connect this computer to another one. Its conversations appear in the shared list, and its tools run there.
addHint: On the other computer, open Remote → Let other devices connect here, copy the pairing link, then paste it here.
slotWarning: Pairing here replaces that desktop's current phone pairing. It can be re-added later with a new link.
errorUnreachable: Couldn't reach that desktop. Make sure it's on and FutureOS is open, with Remote desktop enabled there.
errorTimeout: That desktop didn't answer in time. Try again in a moment — if it keeps happening, check both computers' network.
errorPairing: That pairing has expired. Generate a new pairing link on the other computer and add it again.
errorSecureChannel: The two computers couldn't set up a secure connection. Update FutureOS on both to the same version, then try again.
errorSignedOut: This computer isn't signed in to FutureOS. Sign in, then connect again.
errorRefused: That desktop refused this computer's access. Pair them again to restore the connection.
loadOlderFailed: Couldn't load earlier messages — click to retry
composerPlaceholder: Describe the task, / for tools and skills, # to reference a conversation
composerPlaceholderSkills: Describe the task, / to use skills, # to reference a conversation
draftChatHint: Start quickly in a temporary workspace FutureOS manages on that computer.
draftWorkspaceHint: Use a project folder and its workspace resources on that computer.
referenceConversationDescription: Insert a link to another conversation
unpairConfirmDesc: This machine will no longer connect to {{name}}. Its conversations disappear from your list.
unpairPendingWarning: Removed locally. The server could not be reached to revoke it; it will be retried.
nameHint: Shown only on this machine. It is never sent to the desktop or the platform.
settingsOfflineHint: This desktop is not connected; settings cannot be read or changed right now.
settingsAutomationHint: These change how that desktop behaves, not this one.
settingAutoUpgradeSkillsHint: Keep that desktop’s skills up to date.
settingAutoTitleHint: Name a new conversation from its first message.
settingSkillRecommendHint: Let that desktop suggest a skill while you type.
settingAutoConnect: Keep the remote desktop on after a restart
settingAutoConnectHint: Whether that computer serves its paired devices again at its next launch — its own Remote switch changes then, not now. Off means the switch is off when it restarts and has to be turned on there.
settingsHostContentHint: Read-only summary here; manage them on the desktop itself.
tasksHint: Scheduled tasks there — on a schedule, on demand, or after another finishes.
iconSectionHint: Shown next to its conversations in the list.
renameHint: The new name is saved on the remote desktop.
forkNotSaved: That reply's turn is not saved on the remote desktop yet. Reopen the conversation and try again.
modelLabel: Model for this conversation (on that computer)
skillsNoneInstalled: Nothing installed on that computer yet.
approvalHint: The approval mode on that computer. This machine has its own, in Settings; changing one does not change the other.

approvalTierDescription.default: File access follows approval rules; allowlisted read-only commands run automatically, other commands ask. No OS sandbox.
approvalTierDescription.manual: File access follows approval rules; allowlisted read-only commands run automatically, other commands ask. No OS sandbox.
approvalTierDescription.sandbox: Commands run in that computer's sandbox and ask for approval when needed.
approvalTierDescription.auto: Automatically reviews actions with sandbox protection.
approvalTierDescription.off: No prompts, no sandbox — every command runs with full access to that computer.

tasksRunGone: That run's conversation is no longer there.
providersRemoteHint: These settings belong to that computer; this machine keeps no copy. A key is written there and only ever read back as set / not set.
providersKeyOnHost: The key is stored on {{name}} only; this machine keeps no copy.
workspacesHint: These are folders on that computer. Renaming, pinning or removing one happens there; conversations keep running on that machine.
workspacesEmpty: That computer has no workspaces yet.
chooseDeviceHint: A workspace is a folder on one computer. Choose that computer.
chooseChatDeviceHint: A conversation is stored on one computer and runs there. Choose that computer first.
workspacesAddHint: The folder must already exist on that computer; the path is that computer's.
workspacesRemoveConfirm: Remove the workspace "{{workspace}}" from {{host}}? Its conversations there are removed with it.
pasteUnreadable: Could not read the pasted file: {{name}}
pasteTooMany: At most {{max}} files can be pasted at once
promptQueued: Message queued — it will be sent when the desktop is reachable again.
promptPending: A message is waiting to be sent.
settingsWindowMissing: This computer is no longer paired.
modelsHint: The models that computer offers. Hide the ones you do not use there.
modelsHiddenHint: Turning a model off stops that computer offering it. This switch writes that computer's own setting.
compactHint: Summarise this conversation's context on the host.
usageUnavailable: The host could not report this conversation's usage: {{message}}
deleteFailed: Some conversations could not be deleted: {{message}}
renameWorkspaceHint: The name changes on the computer that owns this folder. Nothing is moved, and the conversations in it are not touched.
